Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeDesc: Pipes auto-connect into a network. Plumb sinks, showers and toilets, and link rain collectors, barrels and vessels to share water. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRiserDesc: A vertical pipe cover for a wall. Connects floor pipes on both sides of the wall and links different floors. Needs a Pipe Wrench.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeHiddenDesc: A concealed water pipe: recessed and plastered over so it stays out of sight, while still auto-connecting and carrying water like a normal pipe. Reveal it with 'Show pipe network'. Needs a Pipe Wrench and a bucket of mixed cement (clay cement or concrete).
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRiserHiddenDesc: A concealed vertical pipe: plastered into the wall so it stays out of sight, while still linking floors and connecting pipes across the wall. Reveal it with 'Show pipe network'. Needs a Pipe Wrench and a bucket of mixed cement (clay cement or concrete).
Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierFilterDesc: A charcoal-filter water purifier. Built inline like a pipe, it cleans the whole connected network's tainted water while it holds a working filter cartridge. Right-click it to replace the cartridge. Most useful with the 'Realistic water purification' sandbox option ON, where taps no longer self-purify.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierFireDesc: A fire-powered water still. Built inline like a pipe, it cleans the connected network's tainted water while a lit heat source (campfire, stove, brazier...) sits right next to it. No cartridges to refill. Most useful with 'Realistic water purification' ON.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPurifierElectricDesc: An electric water distiller. Built inline like a pipe, it automatically cleans the connected network's tainted water whenever it has power (a running generator nearby or grid power). Most useful with 'Realistic water purification' ON.
Tooltip_WaterFilterCartridge: A replaceable charcoal-and-cloth filter for a Filter Water Purifier. Right-click the purifier to install it and restore its purifying charges.
Tooltip_craft_WaterPipeRouterDesc: A directional fluid router. It splits a pipe run into two SEPARATE networks - an IN side and an OUT side - that exchange only through a container placed on its tile. Put a purifier there to clean water as it passes, or a plain container to buffer it. Set the IN->OUT direction from the right-click menu.
